desc: Read the tree and compute degrees.
Build adjacency list from input edges.
For each vertex `c`, collect `k = deg(v)-1` for each neighbor `v` where `k >= 1`.
Sort this list descending and compute the maximum value of `i * (1 + a_i)` (i.e., (i+1) * (1 + a[i]) including center).
Keep track of the maximum total kept vertices across all centers.
